registry.coverage_note: A bounded manual registry of known cash-acquisition events, not a live news feed, exhaustive corporate-action screen, or clearance of unlisted stocks. Cash reuse: US stock trades generally settle T+1; a sale does not establish immediately spendable cash. Check availability and any cash-account restrictions with your broker.
